lines.zh: 星期六想办活动，谁来当组长？
lines.py: xīng qī liù xiǎng bàn huó dòng , shéi lái dāng zǔ zhǎng ?
lines.en: We want to organize an event on Saturday. Who will lead?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我可以当，但先说活动的目的吧。
lines.py: wǒ kě yǐ dāng , dàn xiān shuō huó dòng de mù dì ba .
lines.en: I can, but first tell me the purpose.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 让大家说汉语，也一起运动。
lines.py: ràng dà jiā shuō hàn yǔ , yě yì qǐ yùn dòng .
lines.en: To let everyone speak Mandarin and exercise together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 名称就叫朋友见面，行吗？
lines.py: míng chēng jiù jiào péng you jiàn miàn , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Can we call it Friends Meet?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。报名以后一定要打篮球吗？
lines.py: xíng . bào míng yǐ hòu yí dìng yào dǎ lán qiú ma ?
lines.en: Fine. Does signing up mean we must play basketball?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用，想参加哪队就先问。网球、排球都还没有确认。
lines.py: bù yòng , xiǎng cān jiā nǎ duì jiù xiān wèn . wǎng qiú , pái qiú dōu hái méi yǒu què rèn .
lines.en: No. Ask about the team you want to join; tennis and volleyball are not confirmed yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 名单上五个人，能组成两队吗？
lines.py: míng dān shàng wǔ gè rén , néng zǔ chéng liǎng duì ma ?
lines.en: There are five on the list. Can we form two teams?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先别分。今天每队三个人，人数还不够。
lines.py: xiān bié fēn . jīn tiān měi duì sān gè rén , rén shù hái bù gòu .
lines.en: Not yet. Today each team needs three; there are not enough people yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 体育场下雨就不能用了吧？
lines.py: tǐ yù chǎng xià yǔ jiù bù néng yòng le ba ?
lines.en: We cannot use the sports ground in rain, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就问体育馆有没有开，别先说一定能用。
lines.py: nà jiù wèn tǐ yù guǎn yǒu méi yǒu kāi , bié xiān shuō yí dìng néng yòng .
lines.en: Then ask whether the sports hall is open; do not say it is definitely available first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我刚举手，是想问规则，不是报名当队长。
lines.py: wǒ gāng jǔ shǒu , shì xiǎng wèn guī zé , bù shì bào míng dāng duì zhǎng .
lines.en: I raised my hand to ask the rules, not to volunteer as captain.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。谁愿意当队长，我们再问。
lines.py: zhī dào le . shéi yuàn yì dāng duì zhǎng , wǒ men zài wèn .
lines.en: Understood. We will ask who wants to be captain.
lines.speaker: b

grammar.pattern: 往
grammar.purpose: Describe the direction of movement
grammar.explanation: 往东走 places 往 plus direction before the motion verb. 往公园走 means move towards the park; it does not prove arrival. 在公园 says where a person is. A route can say 从学校往东走, keeping the start and direction separate. Distance and road availability are additional information, not supplied by 往.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我往公园，所以我已经在公园里。
commonMistakes.why: Moving towards a destination does not assert being inside it.

grammar.pattern: 向
grammar.purpose: Orient an action or direct it towards a target
grammar.explanation: 向左看 gives the direction of looking; 向老师问路 names the person addressed. 向 can introduce direction or an action’s target, so the following verb matters. 向东走 describes movement; 向东看 describes looking. Do not equate left with east without a known orientation. Here the map is explicitly north-up.

grammar.pattern: 从：起点和依据
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a starting point from a basis for judgment
grammar.explanation: 从学校出发 gives a spatial start; 从小 gives a temporal start. 从他说的话看 introduces a basis for a limited judgment. That evidence does not justify guesses about someone’s whole life or family. 从…看 is not a verb of physical travel. Ask instead of inferring background from voice, age or appearance.

commonMistakes.wrong: 从她的脸看，她一定住在北方。
commonMistakes.why: Appearance does not establish where someone lives.

grammar.pattern: 是 … 的：时间、地点、方式、施事
grammar.purpose: Focus on circumstances of an already-established event
grammar.explanation: 我们是在活动上认识的 focuses on where the known meeting occurred. 是去年认识的 focuses on time, 是朋友介绍的 on who introduced you, and 是坐车来的 on how you came. This construction does not make a planned future event completed. In casual speech 是 can be omitted: 我们去年认识的. Do not infer a closer relationship just from 见过.

grammar.explanation: 对朋友友好 describes how someone treats friends. 对这个安排满意 identifies the arrangement being evaluated. Keep the target explicit; a comment on an arrangement is not a judgement about the whole person. 对 is a preposition here; 对 meaning correct was taught earlier.

grammar.pattern: A 跟 B 一样 / 相同；A 跟 B 一样 + 形容词
grammar.purpose: Compare a specified quality
grammar.explanation: 她跟姐姐一样安静 compares quietness, not every feature of the two people. 我们的想法相同 compares the stated idea. 她像姐姐 gives resemblance and may be less exact. Avoid using 一样 as evidence for unmentioned private facts. Name the quality or topic being compared.

lines.zh: 她跟姐姐一样安静吗？
lines.py: tā gēn jiě jie yī yàng ān jìng ma ?
lines.en: Is she as quiet as her elder sister?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 平时是，但唱歌时不一样，很有力量。
lines.py: píng shí shì , dàn chàng gē shí bù yī yàng , hěn yǒu lì liàng .
lines.en: In everyday life, yes; when singing, she is different and powerful.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那她们的想法也完全相同吗？
lines.py: nà tā men de xiǎng fǎ yě wán quán xiāng tóng ma ?
lines.en: Then are their ideas completely identical too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不知道。安静只是一个特点，不是所有的想法。
lines.py: bù zhī dào . ān jìng zhǐ shì yī gè tè diǎn , bù shì suǒ yǒu de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: We do not know. Quietness is one characteristic, not every idea.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你对她的态度怎么样？

lines.zh: 我关心她，也尊重她想不想回答。
lines.py: wǒ guān xīn tā , yě zūn zhòng tā xiǎng bù xiǎng huí dá .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她很实在，答应的事认真做。
lines.py: tā hěn shí zai , dā yìng de shì rèn zhēn zuò .
lines.en: She is unpretentious and takes promises seriously.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那咱们先问她想参加什么，别替她选择。
lines.py: nà zán men xiān wèn tā xiǎng cān jiā shén me , bié tì tā xuǎn zé .

lines.speaker: b

grammar.pattern: 离 + 地点 / 时间 + 距离
grammar.purpose: State distance relative to a reference point
grammar.explanation: 入口离湖一公里 names the entrance as the subject and lake as the reference. 地图上直线距离 and actual walking distance can differ; use the label given. 离星期六还有两天 similarly measures remaining time. 不远 is an evaluation and does not supply an exact number.

grammar.pattern: 形容词 + 数量补语
grammar.purpose: Express a measured difference or extent
grammar.explanation: 北边的路比南边的路长两百米 states a measured difference, not the total length. This note gives south route one kilometre and north route one point two kilometres, so the difference is two hundred metres. A road two metres wider describes width, not distance from a place. Keep the unit and comparison explicit.

examples.zh: 北边的路比南边的路长两百米。

examples.en: The north route is two hundred metres longer than the south route.

commonMistakes.why: A comparative difference is not the total length.

grammar.purpose: Identify whom an action benefits
grammar.explanation: 为朋友打印 identifies the beneficiary. 给朋友两页材料 identifies the recipient in a transfer; the patterns can describe different aspects of the same event. 为 wèi here is not wéi in 成为. A beneficiary phrase does not prove that permission has been obtained. Ask first when the action affects another person’s records.

examples.en: First clarify for her, then give her a reply.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我为她同意参加，所以她一定愿意。
commonMistakes.right: 先取得她的同意，再帮她报名。
commonMistakes.why: An action for someone is not evidence of their consent.

grammar.pattern: 有 + 意思 / 用 / 时间等：评价或条件
grammar.purpose: Read 有 in a stated evaluation
grammar.explanation: 这份材料有用 evaluates usefulness, rather than saying the material owns a physical object called 用. 很有意思 evaluates interest. 我有时间 remains an availability statement. Identify the whole phrase; possession and evaluation are separate uses, and usefulness depends on the stated task.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这材料是有用的东西有。
commonMistakes.why: Use 有用 as the evaluation predicate.

lines.zh: 你下午有时间吗？能为我打印材料吗？
lines.py: nǐ xià wǔ yǒu shí jiān ma ? néng wèi wǒ dǎ yìn cái liào ma ?
lines.en: Do you have time this afternoon? Can you print materials for me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，哪几页？
lines.py: kě yǐ , nǎ jǐ yè ?

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 第二页和第三页，两页就够。
lines.py: dì èr yè hé dì sān yè , liǎng yè jiù gòu .
lines.en: Pages two and three; two pages are enough.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。办公室几点开？
lines.py: hǎo . bàn gōng shì jǐ diǎn kāi ?

lines.zh: 活动也帮我报名吧。
lines.py: huó dòng yě bāng wǒ bào míng ba .
lines.en: Please sign me up for the activity too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先取得你的同意：是星期六的活动吗？
lines.py: xiān qǔ dé nǐ de tóng yì : shì xīng qī liù de huó dòng ma ?
lines.en: First let me get your consent: do you mean Saturday’s activity?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 办公室下午两点开，里面有计算机。
lines.py: bàn gōng shì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi , lǐ miàn yǒu jì suàn jī .

lines.py: jiào shì hái zài shàng kè , bù qù nà lǐ qǔ .

grammar.pattern: 或 / 或者：陈述中的选择
grammar.purpose: Offer alternatives in a statement
grammar.explanation: 米饭或者面条都可以 offers either option in a statement. In the focused choice question 你想吃米饭还是面条？ use 还是. 或 is often concise or written; 或者 is ordinary in these statements. 或者 may have other uses, but this card teaches the alternative within the sentence, not a prediction.

examples.en: Rice or noodles are both fine.

examples.py: kě yǐ xiān dú huò xiān tīng .
examples.en: You may read first or listen first.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng chī mǐ fàn hái shi miàn tiáo ?
examples.en: Do you want rice or noodles?

commonMistakes.wrong: 你想吃米饭或者面条？我问你选哪个。
commonMistakes.why: Use 还是 to ask the focused choice between the listed options.

grammar.pattern: 选择复句：是 … 还是 …；… 或者 …
grammar.purpose: Keep the choice scope explicit
grammar.explanation: 是先听再读，还是先读再听？ asks between two complete action sequences. 先听再读，或者先读再听，都可以 permits either sequence. Adding 吗 normally makes a yes-no question about a proposal, rather than the focused choice practised here. Answer with the chosen option or explain that both are acceptable.

lines.zh: 听说今晚有音乐会，是真的吗？

lines.en: I have heard there is a concert tonight; is that true?
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: hái yào què rèn . xiān kàn xiāo xī ba .
lines.en: It still needs confirmation. Let us check the message first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 如果有，音乐会以前还是以后吃饭？
lines.py: rú guǒ yǒu , yīn yuè huì yǐ qián hái shi yǐ hòu chī fàn ?
lines.en: If there is, eat before or after the concert?

lines.zh: 以后吃。你想吃米饭还是面条？
lines.py: yǐ hòu chī . nǐ xiǎng chī mǐ fàn hái shi miàn tiáo ?

lines.py: mǐ fàn huò zhě miàn tiáo dōu kě yǐ , nǐ xuǎn ba .
lines.en: Rice or noodles are both fine; you choose.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: wǒ píng shí xǐ huān mǐ fàn , bù guò jīn tiān xiǎng chī miàn tiáo .
lines.en: I usually like rice, but today I want noodles.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，面条。先确认音乐会，不是现在就出门。
lines.py: hǎo , miàn tiáo . xiān què rèn yīn yuè huì , bù shì xiàn zài jiù chū mén .
lines.en: Okay, noodles. First confirm the concert; do not leave right now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，听说不是已经确认。
lines.py: duì , tīng shuō bù shì yǐ jīng què rèn .
lines.en: Right; having heard about it is not confirmation.
lines.speaker: b

grammar.pattern: 不过 / 但 / 但是 / 而且 / 那 / 如果 / 虽然 / 只要
grammar.purpose: Choose the connective that matches the relation
grammar.explanation: 不过、但、但是 introduce contrast; 而且 adds another point; 那 introduces a response to the previous situation. 如果 makes a condition and 只要 makes it sufficient. 虽然 concedes a fact before the contrast. The same clauses cannot freely swap all these words: 开心 is conceded, 旁边上课 is a cause, and 换到外面 is a proposed response. Keep each clause’s relation explicit.

commonMistakes.wrong: 声音大，而且我们需要小声。这里是在转折。
commonMistakes.right: 声音大，不过我们可以小声说。
commonMistakes.why: When contrasting a problem with a remedy, 不过 fits the stated relation.

grammar.pattern: 虽然 … 但是 / 可是 / 不过；转折复句
grammar.purpose: Concede a point while stating a limitation
grammar.explanation: 虽然开心，但是不能影响别人 concedes happiness and sets a boundary. In natural conversation the second marker may be omitted when the contrast is clear. 虽然…所以 does not express the intended contrast. A criticism of volume is not a rejection of the idea or person; preserve both propositions.

grammar.pattern: 得：动词后的状态补语标记
grammar.purpose: Place the state after the action
grammar.explanation: 说得清楚 and 唱得好 evaluate the action. 得 is neutral de here, not dé obtain or děi have to. With an object, repeat the verb or place the object before it: 这句话你说得很清楚 or 你说汉语说得很清楚. The complement is an evaluation of the stated action, not an automatic proficiency grade.

examples.py: nǐ shuō de hěn qīng chǔ .
examples.en: You speak very clearly.

examples.py: zhè jù huà tā dú de hěn màn .
examples.en: She reads this sentence very slowly.

examples.py: tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo .
examples.en: She sings very well.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她唱歌得很好。
commonMistakes.why: Repeat the verb when keeping the object between the first verb and complement.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 得 + 形容词：状态补语
grammar.purpose: Describe how the action is performed
grammar.explanation: 读得慢 describes the manner of reading, while 读懂 describes a resulting understanding. 说得不清楚 negates the manner, not whether anything was said. 可以说得更慢 is an actionable request. Longer or louder speech does not by itself prove correct tones or fluent conversation.

examples.py: wǒ dú de màn , dàn dú dǒng le .
examples.en: I read slowly but understood.

examples.zh: 第二句说得不清楚，请再说一次。
examples.py: dì èr jù shuō de bù qīng chǔ , qǐng zài shuō yī cì .
examples.en: The second sentence was unclear; please say it again.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ shuō de gèng màn yī diǎn .
examples.en: You can speak a little more slowly.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不说得清楚。意思是说了，但不清楚。
commonMistakes.why: Negate the complement when the action occurred but its manner was unclear.

grammar.pattern: 过：经历标记
grammar.purpose: Report experience without claiming a current event
grammar.explanation: 去过 means having had the experience. 没去过 denies experience; 不去 is refusal or a plan not to go. 去过 does not specify when, so add 前年 when relevant. 不要 infer that a museum is open now from having visited it before. The particle is neutral guo, unlike full-tone guò in passing by.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo , dàn bù shì jīn nián .
examples.en: I have been, but not this year.

examples.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà gè dì fāng .
examples.en: I have never been to that place.

examples.py: qián nián wǒ cān guān guo nà lǐ .
examples.en: I visited it the year before last.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不去过。意思是没有这个经历。
commonMistakes.why: Negate past experience with 没.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 过：曾经发生的经历
grammar.purpose: Separate experience, plans and current confirmation
grammar.explanation: 我坐过船 but 今天船还没开 separates a past experience from today’s departure. 我想参观 is a desire, not a completed visit. 我去年去的 answers the time of an established event; 我去过 answers whether the experience exists. A trip can have occurred without establishing present conditions or expertise.

examples.zh: 我坐过船，今天还要看发船时间。
examples.py: wǒ zuò guo chuán , jīn tiān hái yào kàn fā chuán shí jiān .
examples.en: I have taken a boat before; today I still need to check its departure time.

examples.zh: 她想参观，还没有参观过。

examples.en: She wants to visit and has not visited before.

examples.zh: 这辆车我没骑过，先问怎么骑。
examples.py: zhè liàng chē wǒ méi qí guo , xiān wèn zěn me qí .
examples.en: I have never ridden this bicycle; first ask how to ride it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我去过，所以今天一定开门。
commonMistakes.right: 我去过，但今天开不开要确认。
commonMistakes.why: A past visit cannot confirm today’s opening.

grammar.pattern: 着：持续状态或动作标记
grammar.purpose: Describe a state that remains
grammar.explanation: 门开着 states that the door is open; 开了门 reports opening it. 他拿着书 describes holding the book, not whether he is reading it. 着 is neutral zhe here. Open doors do not establish permission, and a continuing position does not prove a completed agreement.

examples.py: mén kāi zhe , xiān qiāo mén ba .
examples.en: The door is open; knock first.

examples.py: tā ná zhe shū , zhàn zài mén biān .
examples.en: She is holding a book and standing by the door.

examples.zh: 大衣挂着，没有放在地上。
examples.py: dà yī guà zhe , méi yǒu fàng zài dì shang .
examples.en: The overcoat is hanging, not on the floor.

commonMistakes.wrong: 门开着了，我是在说现在的状态。
commonMistakes.why: For this plain state description use 着; do not add 了 without a change-of-state context.

grammar.pattern: 处所 + 是 / 有 / 动词着：存现
grammar.purpose: Locate what exists in a place
grammar.explanation: 门边有椅子 introduces chairs at the door. 门边是洗手间 identifies what that location is. 桌上放着书 describes books positioned on the table. The place comes first in these existential descriptions. Compare 椅子在门边, which locates an already mentioned chair. Keep introduction and identification distinct.

examples.py: mén biān yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
examples.en: There are two chairs by the door.

examples.py: mén biān shì xǐ shǒu jiān .
examples.en: The place beside the door is the bathroom.

examples.py: zhuō shàng fàng zhe yī běn shū .
examples.en: A book is lying on the table.

commonMistakes.wrong: 门边在两把椅子。
commonMistakes.why: Introduce the chairs at a location with 有.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 着：持续；伴随状态
grammar.purpose: Read a state accompanying another action
grammar.explanation: 拿着书说话 describes talking while holding a book. The holding accompanies the speaking and does not imply reading. 门开着 is a continuing state; 开门了 is an event or change. Do not infer consent to enter from the physical state, or infer a signed rental from viewing a room.

examples.py: tā ná zhe shū jiè shào fáng jiān .
examples.en: She introduces the room while holding a book.

examples.py: wǒ zhàn zhe děng , méi yǒu zuò xià .
examples.en: I wait standing and have not sat down.

examples.zh: 桌上放着杯子，朋友在旁边说话。
examples.py: zhuō shàng fàng zhe bēi zi , péng you zài páng biān shuō huà .
examples.en: A cup sits on the table and the friend is talking nearby.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她拿着书，所以一定正在读。
commonMistakes.right: 她拿着书，但现在在说话。
commonMistakes.why: Holding a book does not establish that reading is occurring.

grammar.pattern: 啊 / 吧 / 的：语气与话语作用
grammar.purpose: Read stance without inventing a new fact
grammar.explanation: 原来是你啊 conveys recognition; 开始吧 is a suggestion. 好的 acknowledges a request, while 我会来的 expresses assurance. These endings affect how a known proposition is presented; 好的 by itself may leave the time or task unclear, so confirm details. 啊 may sound different after different syllables in natural speech; cite a neutral a and listen to the connected example.

examples.py: yuán lái shì nǐ a .
examples.en: Oh, it is you.

examples.py: xiān kàn tōng zhī ba .
examples.en: Let us look at the notice first.

examples.py: hǎo de , wǒ xiān wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: Okay, I will ask the time first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 开始啊吗吧。这里要给一个建议。
commonMistakes.why: Use the intended suggestion ending rather than stack incompatible endings.

grammar.pattern: 什么的：非穷尽列举
grammar.purpose: Recognize a casual list with unlisted members
grammar.explanation: 书、笔什么的 means things like books and pens; it is not a precise inventory or a question asking what. In a formal list 书、笔等 can serve a similar function. Do not use a vague list for a task needing exact quantities: 两本书、一支笔 is specific. 什么的 does not prove every possible item is included.

examples.py: dài shū , bǐ shén me de jiù xíng .
examples.en: Things like books and pens are enough.

examples.py: wǒ dài bào zhǐ , shū děng .
examples.en: I bring newspapers, books and so on.

examples.zh: 需要两本书，不是随便什么都行。
examples.py: xū yào liǎng běn shū , bù shì suí biàn shén me dōu xíng .
examples.en: Two books are needed, not just anything.

commonMistakes.wrong: 要两本书，带什么的。这是准确数量。
commonMistakes.why: When a quantity is exact, state it rather than imply an open list.

grammar.pattern: 名词 / 代词 + 呢：承接已有话题
grammar.purpose: Recover the omitted question from context
grammar.explanation: 我想读报纸。你呢？ asks what you would like to read, not where you are. 报纸呢？ after looking for objects can mean where the newspaper is. Read the preceding exchange before expanding the omission; 呢 itself does not encode one fixed full question. If uncertain, ask 你是问我想读什么吗？.

grammar.pattern: 的话 / 等：条件与列举
grammar.purpose: Read the whole phrase instead of its literal pieces
grammar.explanation: 有空的话 introduces a condition, not somebody’s spoken words. 药片、药水等 is a non-exhaustive list, not an instruction to wait. Compare 等一会儿, the waiting verb in another context. Neither an open list nor a condition provides missing doses, dates or permission.

examples.zh: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿。
examples.py: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er .
examples.en: If convenient, I will come and sit a while.

examples.py: yào piàn , yào shuǐ děng dōu xiān fàng hǎo .
examples.en: Put the tablets, liquid medicine and so on properly in place first.

examples.zh: 等一会儿，再问她方便不方便。
examples.py: děng yī huì er , zài wèn tā fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
examples.en: Wait a while, then ask whether it is convenient for her.

commonMistakes.wrong: 有空的话，所以我一定来。意思是还要看方便不方便。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the visit conditional instead of asserting certain arrival.

grammar.pattern: 不一会儿：短时间后的变化
grammar.purpose: Recognize a short unspecified interval
grammar.explanation: 不一会儿电话响了 describes a short interval before a change. It does not mean an exact five minutes. 坐一会儿 states a short duration of sitting; 不一会儿…了 introduces what happens afterward. If the visit needs an exact end time, ask and state it separately.

examples.py: bù yī huì er , tā huí le xiāo xī .
examples.en: A little later, she replied to the message.

examples.py: wǒ zuò yī huì er jiù zǒu .
examples.en: I will sit a short while and then leave.

examples.zh: 五点离开，这是确认的时间。
examples.py: wǔ diǎn lí kāi , zhè shì què rèn de shí jiān .
examples.en: Leave at five; that is the confirmed time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不一会儿一定就是五分钟。
commonMistakes.right: 不一会儿说的是短时间，不是准确分钟。
commonMistakes.why: The expression itself does not supply an exact duration.

grammar.pattern: 喂：电话开场的叹词
grammar.purpose: Open a telephone call and identify yourself
grammar.explanation: 喂，你好，我是… can open a call. Use the stated greeting and identify yourself, then ask whether speaking is convenient. Do not read it as 喂动物 feed animals, another full-tone reading and meaning. A greeting is not consent to a long call; allow the listener to decline.

examples.py: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng .
examples.en: Hello, this is Xiao Wang.

examples.py: xiàn zài fāng biàn shuō huà ma ?

examples.zh: 不方便的话，我晚点儿再联系。
examples.py: bù fāng biàn de huà , wǒ wǎn diǎn ér zài lián xì .
examples.en: If inconvenient, I will contact you later.

commonMistakes.wrong: 喂！必须现在一直说。
commonMistakes.why: The greeting should not become a demand for an uninterrupted call.

grammar.pattern: 越来越 + 形容词 / 心理动词
grammar.purpose: Describe change along a timeline
grammar.explanation: 越来越清楚 compares later states with earlier ones. It does not say two people have equal ability or that a qualification has been achieved. 越练习，越清楚 links two changing quantities. Read the actual record before judging how much progress was made; increasingly is not a numerical score.

examples.zh: 第一次不清楚，现在越来越清楚。
examples.py: dì yī cì bù qīng chǔ , xiàn zài yuè lái yuè qīng chǔ .
examples.en: It was unclear the first time; now it is becoming clearer.

examples.py: yuè liàn xí , yuè yǒu xìn xīn .
examples.en: The more you practise, the more confident you become.

examples.zh: 越来越喜欢，不等于已经看完。
examples.py: yuè lái yuè xǐ huān , bù děng yú yǐ jīng kàn wán .
examples.en: Liking it more and more does not mean having finished it.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我越来越昨天清楚。
commonMistakes.right: 我现在比昨天清楚，也越来越有信心。
commonMistakes.why: Use 比 for an explicit comparison and 越来越 for a developing trend.

grammar.pattern: 不但…而且… / 还 / 更
grammar.purpose: Add information and identify a stronger point
grammar.explanation: 不但能读，而且能说 adds a second ability. 更清楚 adds a stronger comparison in context; 还 can add another point. With one shared subject, 我不但…而且… is natural. When subjects differ, 不但我…，而且她… places the connective before the first subject. Neither construction implies perfection.

examples.py: tā bù dàn néng dú , ér qiě néng shuō .
examples.en: She can not only read but also speak.

examples.zh: 不但我参加，而且她也参加。
examples.py: bù dàn wǒ cān jiā , ér qiě tā yě cān jiā .
examples.en: Not only I but she too takes part.

examples.py: xiàn zài hái gèng yǒu xìn xīn .
examples.en: Now there is also more confidence.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不但我能读，所以能说。这里要补充另一点。
commonMistakes.why: An additive relation is not the same as a causal one.

grammar.pattern: 名词性谓语：年龄、日期等
grammar.purpose: Recognize bounded short nominal statements
grammar.explanation: 我二十二岁 and 今天星期三 can stand without 是 in familiar age/date contexts. This is not a rule to delete 是 from every identification: 她是商人 remains a normal noun classification. Negative age/date claims normally use 不是: 今天不是星期二. Ask what is being stated before expanding an omitted verb.

examples.py: wǒ èr shí èr suì .
examples.en: I am twenty-two.

examples.py: jīn tiān xīng qī sān .
examples.en: Today is Wednesday.

examples.py: tā shì shāng rén .
examples.en: She is a businessperson.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她商人。这里是在介绍身份。
commonMistakes.why: Keep 是 in this neutral identity introduction; short age/date patterns do not license every noun predicate.

grammar.pattern: 主谓句：名词性谓语句
grammar.purpose: Interpret topic, nominal predicate and scope
grammar.explanation: 今天星期三 has the topic 今天 and nominal predicate 星期三. 她今年二十二岁 states her age this year, not her birthday or birthplace. 这本书三十五块 gives a price in context. Use 不是 to reject a stated value and supply the actual one; these patterns do not establish unrelated facts.

examples.py: tā jīn nián èr shí èr suì .
examples.en: She is twenty-two this year.

examples.py: zhè běn shū sān shí wǔ kuài .
examples.en: This book is thirty-five yuan.

examples.zh: 今天不是星期二，是星期三。
examples.py: jīn tiān bù shì xīng qī èr , shì xīng qī sān .
examples.en: Today is not Tuesday; it is Wednesday.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她今年二十二岁，所以知道生日是哪天。
commonMistakes.right: 她今年二十二岁，生日是哪天还没说。
commonMistakes.why: An age does not identify the birthday date.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 好 / 完 / 到 / 见 / 懂 / 清楚
grammar.purpose: Check the resulting state rather than infer it from an action
grammar.explanation: 做饭 names an activity; 做好饭 says the preparation reaches the intended ready state. 看完 says reading finished, 看懂 says it was understood, 看见 says something was perceived. 听清楚 is clearer perception, not necessarily comprehension. Negative result uses 没有: 没听清楚. Do not claim a safe temperature or successful outcome just because someone tried.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 来 / 去；动词 + 上 / 下 / 进 / 出 / 回 / 过 / 起
grammar.purpose: Locate movement and its direction
grammar.explanation: 端出来 is movement out toward the speaker or the scene’s reference point; 端出去 moves out away from it. 拿上 indicates movement upward, 拿下 downward, 拿进去 into somewhere. Mark the location before choosing 来/去. The directional complement is not proof that the object is cooked or that permission was granted.

grammar.pattern: 同一主语 + 动词短语 + 动词短语
grammar.purpose: Recognize linked actions with one subject
grammar.explanation: 我去商店买东西 uses the same subject for going and buying; buying is the purpose of the trip. 我拿杯子喝水 links taking a cup to drinking. Do not change the subject midway without stating it. A purpose is not a completed result: 去买 does not guarantee 买到.

grammar.pattern: 因为…所以…：因果关系
grammar.purpose: Identify the stated cause and consequence
grammar.explanation: 因为先分好工作，所以大家没有重复劳动 connects a stated cause with its consequence. A consequence is not proof that every earlier event caused it. Either connective may be omitted when the relation is clear, but 但是 marks contrast instead. Use the evidence in the scene, not a new causal story invented from a score or appearance.

examples.zh: 因为先分好工作，所以更顺利。
examples.py: yīn wèi xiān fēn hǎo gōng zuò , suǒ yǐ gèng shùn lì .
examples.en: Because the work was divided first, things went more smoothly.

examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们换了地方。
examples.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ , wǒ men huàn le dì fāng .
examples.en: Because it rained, we changed the location.

examples.zh: 大家先确认了，所以不用再猜。
examples.py: dà jiā xiān què rèn le , suǒ yǐ bù yòng zài cāi .
examples.en: Everyone confirmed first, so there is no need to guess again.

commonMistakes.wrong: 因为下雨，所以太阳就是经理。
commonMistakes.right: 因为下雨，所以我们换了地方。
commonMistakes.why: Supply the actual consequence rather than an unrelated identity.

grammar.pattern: 给 + 接收者 / 受益者
grammar.purpose: Retrieve the recipient in a recap
grammar.explanation: 给朋友倒水 identifies who receives water; 给老师发消息 identifies the message recipient. It does not mean the recipient did the pouring or sending. Say the recipient when the context needs one, and distinguish an offer from its accepted completion.

examples.py: wǒ gěi péng you dào shuǐ .
examples.en: I pour water for a friend.

examples.py: tā gěi lǎo shī fā xiāo xī .
examples.en: She sends the teacher a message.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ zhào xiàng , kě yǐ ma ?
examples.en: I would like to photograph you; is that okay?

commonMistakes.wrong: 我给朋友倒水，所以朋友给我倒水。
commonMistakes.right: 我给朋友倒水，朋友收到了水。
commonMistakes.why: Do not reverse the agent and recipient.

grammar.pattern: 第一步…第二步…最后…
grammar.purpose: Retrieve ordinal steps in an explanation
grammar.explanation: 第一步查做法，第二步分工作，最后核对结果 states an ordered plan. 第一 is ordinal and differs from 一次, a count. An ordered plan is not itself proof that every step was done. Match the recap with the actual scene and preserve a missed or unfinished step.

examples.zh: 第一步看通知，第二步问时间。
examples.py: dì yī bù kàn tōng zhī , dì èr bù wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: First check the notice; second ask the time.

examples.py: zuì hòu hé duì jié guǒ .
examples.en: Finally check the results.

examples.py: dì sān bù hái méi zuò .
examples.en: The third step has not been done yet.

commonMistakes.wrong: 第一步还没做，所以都做完了。
commonMistakes.right: 第一步还没做，不能说都做完了。
commonMistakes.why: An unfinished step prevents a claim that all steps are complete.

grammar.pattern: 第- / 老- / 小-：前缀与语境
grammar.purpose: Distinguish order from a familiar surname address
grammar.explanation: 第三位成员 is ordinal. 老李 and 小李 can be familiar address forms before surnames; they do not prove a person is old or small, and are not automatically suitable for strangers. Names like 小林 may also be someone’s actual given name: ask instead of assuming a prefix. 第 is not used before every numeral phrase: 三位成员 counts people, 第三位成员 selects their order.

examples.py: dì sān wèi chéng yuán hái méi dào .
examples.en: The third member has not arrived.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ jiào wǒ xiǎo lǐ .
examples.en: You may call me Xiao Li.

examples.zh: 老李是熟人之间的称呼。
examples.py: lǎo lǐ shì shú rén zhī jiān de chēng hū .
examples.en: Lao Li is a form of address among familiar people.

commonMistakes.wrong: 三位成员就是第三位成员。
commonMistakes.right: 三位成员是人数，第三位成员是顺序。
commonMistakes.why: Keep quantity and order distinct.

grammar.pattern: -儿 / -家 / -们 / -头 / -子：构词与读音
grammar.purpose: Recognize a suffix without replacing a word’s lexical meaning
grammar.explanation: 朋友们 marks a group; 桌子 has neutral zi, 里头 commonly neutral tou, and 科学家 denotes a practitioner. 画儿 may use rhotic huàr rather than an extra ér syllable. Some forms are lexicalized: 母亲中的亲 is not one of these suffixes. 三个朋友 does not normally become 三个朋友们. Do not attach each suffix freely or treat every final 家 as a role suffix; 我家 means my home.

grammar.pattern: 敢 + 动词：勇气与意愿
grammar.purpose: Separate willingness from ability and permission
grammar.explanation: 敢说 expresses daring to speak despite hesitation. 不敢 says the courage is lacking; it does not prove the person cannot speak or is prohibited. 敢不敢试？ asks willingness; 能不能试？ may ask ability or permission in context. Do not pressure a refusal: 可以先听 allows a gradual start.

examples.py: wǒ bù gǎn shuō , dàn tīng dé dǒng .
examples.en: I do not dare speak, but can understand.

examples.py: gǎn bù gǎn xiān shì yī jù ?
examples.en: Would you dare try one sentence first?

examples.zh: 现在不想试，也可以先听。
examples.py: xiàn zài bù xiǎng shì , yě kě yǐ xiān tīng .
examples.en: If you do not want to try now, you may listen first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不敢说就是不会说。
commonMistakes.right: 不敢说不一定是不会说。
commonMistakes.why: Courage, competence and permission are separate meanings.

grammar.pattern: 谁都 / 哪儿都 / 疑问词呼应 / 不定指
grammar.purpose: Read a question word used without a question
grammar.explanation: 谁都可以先来听 means everyone is permitted to listen; 谁可以来听？ asks who may attend. 你想读什么，就读什么 links the selected object across clauses. 我想问你什么事 is unnatural for the intended vague sense; 我想问你点儿什么 can mean something unspecified, while 我想问你一件事 is clearer. Scope matters: 谁都 can be narrowed by the notice, and 谁都不 says nobody.

examples.py: shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
examples.en: Anyone may come and listen first.

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng dú shén me , jiù dú shén me .
examples.en: Read whatever you want to read.

examples.zh: 今天哪儿都不去，就在这里。
examples.py: jīn tiān nǎr dōu bù qù , jiù zài zhè lǐ .
examples.en: Go nowhere today; stay here.

commonMistakes.wrong: 谁都不去就是谁都去。
commonMistakes.right: 谁都不去，就是没有人去。
commonMistakes.why: The negation changes an inclusive claim to nobody.

lines.zh: 各位，今天谁都可以先来听。
lines.py: gè wèi , jīn tiān shéi dōu kě yǐ xiān lái tīng .
lines.en: Everyone, anyone may come and listen first today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用比赛资格吗？
lines.py: bù yòng bǐ sài zī gé ma ?
lines.en: No competition eligibility needed?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 旁听不用，比赛报名要另看标准。
lines.py: páng tīng bù yòng , bǐ sài bào míng yào lìng kàn biāo zhǔn .
lines.en: Not for listening; competition registration has separate criteria.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我有点儿害怕，不敢马上说。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér hài pà , bù gǎn mǎ shàng shuō .
lines.en: I am a little afraid and do not dare speak immediately.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以先听。想读什么，就先选什么。
lines.py: kě yǐ xiān tīng . xiǎng dú shén me , jiù xiān xuǎn shén me .
lines.en: You may listen first. Start by selecting what you want to read.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 各种难度都有，每个人必须全读吗？
lines.py: gè zhǒng nán dù dōu yǒu , měi gè rén bì xū quán dú ma ?
lines.en: There are various difficulties; must each person read them all?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不用，大家各自选一段，时间足够。
lines.py: bù yòng , dà jiā gè zì xuǎn yī duàn , shí jiān zú gòu .
lines.en: No; each chooses one passage and there is enough time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我先选容易的一段，再试一句。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xiān xuǎn róng yì de yī duàn , zài shì yī jù .
lines.en: Okay; I will choose an easy passage first and then try one sentence.
lines.speaker: b

grammar.pattern: 需要 + 名词 / 动词短语
grammar.purpose: State a need without turning it into consent
grammar.explanation: 活动需要两个人 states a staffing need; 我需要休息 states a personal need. 需要 is not a volunteer’s promise. 不需要 contrasts absence of need with 不愿意, lack of willingness. Questions like 需要我帮忙吗？ offer help and still await an answer. State quantity and task scope, not a blanket requirement to obey.

grammar.pattern: 各 / 各位 / 各种 / 每 / 任何
grammar.purpose: Read distribution and the bounds of a general claim
grammar.explanation: 各组 distributes work by group; 每个人 by individual. 各位 politely addresses those present, not the whole world. 各种 names different kinds, not necessarily every possible type. 任何人都可以询问 uses any within the stated context; 任何人都不 may deny permission to everyone in that context. Always recover what set the statement concerns.

grammar.pattern: 动宾式离合词：对象、数量和时长
grammar.purpose: Place added material inside the separable construction
grammar.explanation: 帮忙 can expand to 帮我一个忙, 见面 to 跟朋友见一次面, 理发 to 理个发, 睡觉 to 睡了一个小时的觉. Do not attach every object after the full compound: 帮忙我 is not the intended standard request. With 结婚 use 跟/和…结婚 rather than 结婚她. The semantic object is built into the compound; duration/number placement depends on the construction, and not every two-character verb is separable.

grammar.pattern: 连动句：同一主语的连续动作或目的
grammar.purpose: Keep the actor and purpose clear in a request
grammar.explanation: 我去办公室复印两页 states my going and copying, with copying as the trip purpose. 她来找我讨论时间 shares one actor across linked verbs. A different actor must be stated separately. 去问时间 describes an intended task, not proof an answer was obtained; ask for the result afterward.

lines.py: fǎng wèn yǐ qián xiān yuē shí jiān , bié tū rán dào .
lines.en: Arrange a time before visiting rather than arriving suddenly.

lines.zh: 她负责接待，不是负责所有安排。
lines.py: tā fù zé jiē dài , bù shì fù zé suǒ yǒu ān pái .
lines.en: She handles reception, not every arrangement.

lines.zh: 改了时间，要及时告诉朋友。
lines.py: gǎi le shí jiān , yào jí shí gào sù péng you .
lines.en: Tell friends promptly if the time changes.

lines.zh: 她及时回了消息，我还没出发。
lines.py: tā jí shí huí le xiāo xī , wǒ hái méi chū fā .
lines.en: She replied promptly, before I had set off.

lines.zh: 提前问清楚，不是提前替她答应。
lines.py: tí qián wèn qīng chǔ , bù shì tí qián tì tā dā yìng .
lines.en: Ask clearly beforehand, rather than agree on her behalf.

lines.zh: 要提前问，不等到门口才说。
lines.py: yào tí qián wèn , bù děng dào mén kǒu cái shuō .
lines.en: Ask in advance, not only on reaching the doorway.

lines.zh: 我想约她见面，时间还没定。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā jiàn miàn , shí jiān hái méi dìng .
lines.en: I want to arrange a meeting with her; the time is not settled.

lines.zh: 我们约了明天下午，不是今天。
lines.py: wǒ men yuē le míng tiān xià wǔ , bù shì jīn tiān .
lines.en: We arranged tomorrow afternoon, not today.

lines.zh: 告别前，再确认明天的时间。
lines.py: gào bié qián , zài què rèn míng tiān de shí jiān .
lines.en: Confirm tomorrow’s time again before saying goodbye.

lines.zh: 活动结束时，先向主人告别。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù shí , xiān xiàng zhǔ rén gào bié .
lines.en: Say goodbye to the host when the event ends.

lines.zh: 朋友结婚了，不等于所有人都参加了婚礼。
lines.py: péng you jié hūn le , bù děng yú suǒ yǒu rén dōu cān jiā le hūn lǐ .
lines.en: A friend married; that does not mean everyone attended the wedding.

lines.zh: 她朋友结婚了，具体安排还要看邀请。
lines.py: tā péng you jié hūn le , jù tǐ ān pái hái yào kàn yāo qǐng .
lines.en: Her friend got married; check the invitation for specific arrangements.

lines.zh: 谈话先问她现在方便不方便。
lines.py: tán huà xiān wèn tā xiàn zài fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
lines.en: Before talking, ask whether now is convenient.

lines.zh: 谈话没结束，我先不打断。
lines.py: tán huà méi jié shù , wǒ xiān bù dǎ duàn .
lines.en: The conversation has not ended; I will not interrupt.

lines.zh: 最后补充一句，我只问时间。
lines.py: zuì hòu bǔ chōng yī jù , wǒ zhǐ wèn shí jiān .
lines.en: Add one final detail: I ask only about the time.

lines.zh: 她们是亲姐妹，不是只看起来像。
lines.py: tā men shì qīn jiě mèi , bù shì zhǐ kàn qǐ lái xiàng .
lines.en: They are biological sisters, not just similar-looking.

lines.zh: 领导不在，可以先问联系人。
lines.py: lǐng dǎo bù zài , kě yǐ xiān wèn lián xì rén .

lines.zh: 领导不在，先问今天谁负责接待。
lines.py: lǐng dǎo bù zài , xiān wèn jīn tiān shéi fù zé jiē dài .
lines.en: The leader is absent; ask who handles reception today.

lines.zh: 交往要相互尊重，不替别人做决定。
lines.py: jiāo wǎng yào xiāng hù zūn zhòng , bù tì bié ren zuò jué dìng .

lines.zh: 交往中有问题，可以先说明自己的需要。

grammar.pattern: 动补式离合：打开 / 看见 / 离开 / 完成
grammar.purpose: Interpret inserted potential material and lexical limits
grammar.explanation: 打开 can contrast with 打不开; 看见 with 看得见/看不见; 离开 with 离不开, often a dependence meaning; 完成 with 完不成. These words are not noun-object compounds like 帮忙 and do not freely accept an object between their syllables. Read the complete construction, not just a separated character. 打不开门 describes inability to open it, not proof nobody tried.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我打开了，所以任务都完成了。
commonMistakes.right: 我打开了文件，但任务还没完成。
commonMistakes.why: Opening a file is distinct from finishing the task.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 到 / 住 / 走：结果
grammar.purpose: Identify achieved finding, retention or removal
grammar.explanation: 找文件 names searching; 找到文件 asserts successful finding. 记住 emphasizes retaining something, and 拿走 removes it from a location. 没找到 negates achieved finding, not necessarily the attempt. Do not treat all complements as interchangeable: 看到了 notices an object, 看懂了 understands its meaning.

grammar.pattern: 把 / 行 / 架 / 群 / 束 / 双 / 台 / 张 / 支 / 只 / 种
grammar.purpose: Use noun classifiers to identify the counted thing
grammar.explanation: 两把椅子 counts chairs; 两双筷子 counts two pairs, normally four individual chopsticks. 一行字 uses háng, not xíng. 一只猫 uses zhī, unlike the adverb 只 zhǐ. 一架钢琴、一台电脑、一束花、一张纸、一支笔、一群人、两种饮料 illustrate common noun combinations. Classifier choice depends on the object and intended grouping, not just its English count.

examples.en: Two chairs and a bunch of flowers.

examples.en: Two pairs of chopsticks, four individual chopsticks.

examples.py: yī háng zì , yī zhī māo .
examples.en: One line of writing and one cat.

commonMistakes.wrong: 两双筷子就是两根筷子。
commonMistakes.right: 两双筷子通常是四根筷子。
commonMistakes.why: Count pairs rather than individual sticks.

grammar.pattern: 顿 / 口 / 眼：动作计量
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a meal, a mouthful and a glance
grammar.explanation: 一顿饭 counts one meal occasion; 一口汤 a mouthful; 看一眼 a brief look. 喝一口 does not mean drinking the whole bowl, and 看一眼 is not evidence of reading every line. These action measures do not provide an exact time or physical volume without further context.

examples.en: Share one meal.

examples.en: Glance at the notice and then read it carefully.

grammar.pattern: 量词重叠：个个 / 本本 / 张张等
grammar.purpose: Read distribution within a stated set
grammar.explanation: 这六张纸张张都有名字 means each of these six sheets bears a name; it does not prove every sheet anywhere is named. 本本都读过 ranges over the books just mentioned. Not every classifier repeats equally naturally in all contexts; use 个个/本本/张张 with a clear noun or preceding set. Compare 每张 rather than invent a new total from repetition.

commonMistakes.why: The distributive scope remains the stated set.

grammar.pattern: 数词 + 量词重复：一个一个 / 一张一张
grammar.purpose: Read sequential handling and context-dependent distribution
grammar.explanation: 一张一张递 describes passing sheets one at a time. 两张两张发 distributes or handles two at a time; with six sheets this means three batches, not two total sheets. 一人一张 states individual allocation and has a different pattern. Repetition alone does not establish the overall quantity or completion.

grammar.pattern: 比较 / 更加 / 还 / 相当：程度
grammar.purpose: Distinguish an explicit comparison from a degree modifier
grammar.explanation: 比较清楚 may mean relatively clear without naming a comparator; 比昨天清楚 is explicit. 更加清楚 builds on a prior degree. 还 can mean even more in 他比我还快, distinct from continuing 还在练. 相当难 means quite difficult here, not a claim two objects are equivalent. Use context, and do not infer a numeric gain.

commonMistakes.wrong: 比较清楚就是一定比所有人清楚。
commonMistakes.right: 比较清楚不一定说了比较对象。
commonMistakes.why: A relative degree word does not identify every comparator.

grammar.pattern: A比B说得清楚 / A不比B快 / 比B多读一遍
grammar.purpose: Compare delivery and quantified differences
grammar.explanation: 她比我说得清楚 and 她说得比我清楚 compare manner. A不比B快 denies A being faster, allowing equality or slower, rather than proving B is strictly faster. 我比她多读一遍 states one extra repetition; 我比她早到十分钟 states a time difference. 不如 often implies inferiority and differs from 不比. Preserve the dimension and stated amount.

lines.zh: 你这一段比较清楚，比昨天怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ zhè yī duàn bǐ jiào qīng chǔ , bǐ zuó tiān zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: This passage is relatively clear; how does it compare with yesterday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天说得比昨天清楚，但不比你快。
lines.py: jīn tiān shuō dé bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ , dàn bù bǐ nǐ kuài .
lines.en: Today I speak more clearly than yesterday, but not faster than you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不比我快，就是一定比我慢吗？
lines.py: bù bǐ wǒ kuài , jiù shì yí dìng bǐ wǒ màn ma ?
lines.en: Not faster than me means certainly slower than me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是，可能一样快。速度没有具体记录。
lines.py: bù shì , kě néng yī yàng kuài . sù dù méi yǒu jù tǐ jì lù .
lines.en: No, possibly equally fast. There is no actual speed record.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你读了几遍？
lines.py: nǐ dú le jǐ biàn ?
lines.en: How many times did you read it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三遍，你两遍，我比你多读一遍。
lines.py: sān biàn , nǐ liǎng biàn , wǒ bǐ nǐ duō dú yī biàn .
lines.en: Three; you read twice, so I read once more.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天先练清楚，演唱时再有舞台的感觉。
lines.py: jīn tiān xiān liàn qīng chǔ , yǎn chàng shí zài yǒu wǔ tái de gǎn jué .
lines.en: Practise clarity first today; add stage energy when singing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，强调意思，不乱改声调。
lines.py: hǎo , qiáng diào yì si , bù luàn gǎi shēng diào .
lines.en: Okay, emphasize meaning without arbitrarily changing tones.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天练原创短句，先说清楚，再演唱。
lines.py: jīn tiān liàn yuán chuàng duǎn jù , xiān shuō qīng chǔ , zài yǎn chàng .
lines.en: Today practise original short lines: speak clearly before singing.

lines.zh: 三遍比两遍多一遍，只说次数，不说谁更有才能。
lines.py: sān biàn bǐ liǎng biàn duō yī biàn , zhǐ shuō cì shù , bù shuō shéi gèng yǒu cái néng .
lines.en: Three repetitions is one more than two; that compares counts, not talent.

lines.zh: 说得比昨天清楚是进步方向，没有准确分数。
lines.py: shuō dé bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ shì jìn bù fāng xiàng , méi yǒu zhǔn què fēn shù .
lines.en: Clearer speech than yesterday indicates a direction of progress, not an exact score.

lines.zh: 不比朋友快可以一样快，不能自动写成更慢。
lines.py: bù bǐ péng you kuài kě yǐ yī yàng kuài , bù néng zì dòng xiě chéng gèng màn .
lines.en: Not faster than a friend may be equally fast; do not automatically report slower.

lines.zh: 艺术表演会改变声音，学习声调要听清楚的说话。
lines.py: yì shù biǎo yǎn huì gǎi biàn shēng yīn , xué xí shēng diào yào tīng qīng chǔ de shuō huà .
lines.en: Artistic performance may alter the voice; learn tones from clear speech.

lines.zh: 舞台也能演话剧，不是所有演员都是歌手。
lines.py: wǔ tái yě néng yǎn huà jù , bù shì suǒ yǒu yǎn yuán dōu shì gē shǒu .
lines.en: A stage can host spoken drama too; not every performer is a singer.

lines.zh: 技术可以进一步改进，乐队没来时也先读文字。
lines.py: jì shù kě yǐ jìn yí bù gǎi jìn , yuè duì méi lái shí yě xiān dú wén zì .
lines.en: Technique can improve further; while the band is absent, read the words first.

lines.zh: 演出精彩不等于任务全完成，记录要具体。
lines.py: yǎn chū jīng cǎi bù děng yú rèn wù quán wán chéng , jì lù yào jù tǐ .
lines.en: An excellent performance does not finish every task; keep records specific.

lines.zh: 说得比昨天清楚是【进步】方向，没有准确分数。

lines.zh: 三遍比两遍，多了一遍。
lines.py: sān biàn bǐ liǎng biàn , duō le yī biàn .
lines.en: Three readings versus two: one extra.

lines.zh: 今天比昨天，清楚一点。
lines.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān , qīng chǔ yī diǎn .
lines.en: Today versus yesterday: a little clearer.

lines.zh: 不比你快，也许一样。
lines.py: bù bǐ nǐ kuài , yě xǔ yī yàng .
lines.en: Not faster than you; perhaps equal.

lines.zh: 声音可以强，声调别乱。
lines.py: shēng yīn kě yǐ qiáng , shēng diào bié luàn .
lines.en: The voice may be strong; do not jumble the tones.

lines.zh: 舞台等一等，文字先看。
lines.py: wǔ tái děng yī děng , wén zì xiān kàn .
lines.en: The stage can wait; read the words first.

lines.zh: 精彩归精彩，记录不夸。
lines.py: jīng cǎi guī jīng cǎi , jì lù bù kuā .
lines.en: Wonderful is wonderful; the record does not exaggerate.

lines.py: zhè yī duàn xiāng dāng nán , xiān màn màn dú .
lines.en: This passage is quite difficult; read it slowly first.

lines.zh: 团队强大，也要听每个人。
lines.py: tuán duì qiáng dà , yě yào tīng měi gè rén .
lines.en: A strong team still needs to hear each person.

lines.zh: 声音强大，不等于每个字都清楚。
lines.py: shēng yīn qiáng dà , bù děng yú měi gè zì dōu qīng chǔ .
lines.en: A powerful voice does not mean every word is clear.

lines.zh: 强调意思，不是乱改声调。
lines.py: qiáng diào yì si , bù shì luàn gǎi shēng diào .
lines.en: Emphasize the meaning rather than randomly changing tones.

lines.zh: 她有强烈的愿望，还要慢慢练。
lines.py: tā yǒu qiáng liè de yuàn wàng , hái yào màn màn liàn .
lines.en: She has a strong wish and still needs gradual practice.

lines.zh: 她想参加的愿望很强烈，也先确认时间。
lines.py: tā xiǎng cān jiā de yuàn wàng hěn qiáng liè , yě xiān què rèn shí jiān .
lines.en: She strongly wants to join and still confirms the time first.

lines.zh: 下一次进一步改进。
lines.py: xià yī cì jìn yí bù gǎi jìn .
lines.en: Make further improvements next time.

lines.zh: 进步要看记录，不靠乱夸。
lines.py: jìn bù yào kàn jì lù , bù kào luàn kuā .
lines.en: Progress depends on records, not exaggerated praise.

lines.zh: 先改进不清楚的地方。
lines.py: xiān gǎi jìn bù qīng chǔ de dì fāng .
lines.en: Improve the unclear parts first.

lines.zh: 技术要练，不只看舞台。
lines.py: jì shù yào liàn , bù zhǐ kàn wǔ tái .
lines.en: Technique needs practice, not just watching a stage.

lines.zh: 艺术表演和考试任务不同。
lines.py: yì shù biǎo yǎn hé kǎo shì rèn wù bù tóng .
lines.en: Artistic performance and exam tasks differ.

lines.zh: 演唱会时间还没确认。
lines.py: yǎn chàng huì shí jiān hái méi què rèn .
lines.en: The concert time is unconfirmed.

lines.zh: 演唱会还没开始，大家先看座位。
lines.py: yǎn chàng huì hái méi kāi shǐ , dà jiā xiān kàn zuò wèi .
lines.en: The concert has not started; everyone checks their seats first.

lines.zh: 演出结束，不等于练习结束。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù , bù děng yú liàn xí jié shù .
lines.en: The performance ending does not mean practice ends.

lines.zh: 演员演的是角色，不是自己的全部生活。
lines.py: yǎn yuán yǎn de shì jué sè , bù shì zì jǐ de quán bù shēng huó .
lines.en: Actors perform roles, not their entire lives.

lines.zh: 喜欢歌手，也要听懂歌词的意思。
lines.py: xǐ huān gē shǒu , yě yào tīng dǒng gē cí de yì si .
lines.en: Liking a singer still calls for understanding the words.

lines.zh: 歌声很强，意思还要看文字。
lines.py: gē shēng hěn qiáng , yì si hái yào kàn wén zì .
lines.en: The singing is strong; check the words for the meaning.

lines.zh: 我听见歌声，歌词却还没听清。
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiàn gē shēng , gē cí què hái méi tīng qīng .
lines.en: I hear singing but have not yet understood the lyrics clearly.

lines.zh: 歌迷也可以先练清楚的一句。
lines.py: gē mí yě kě yǐ xiān liàn qīng chǔ de yī jù .
lines.en: A music fan can start by practising one clear sentence.

lines.zh: 歌迷也可以安静地听，不必一直喊。
lines.py: gē mí yě kě yǐ ān jìng de tīng , bù bì yì zhí hǎn .
lines.en: A fan can listen quietly without shouting all the time.

grammar.pattern: 光 / 仅 / 仅仅 / 就 / 至少
grammar.purpose: Read scope and minimum quantities accurately
grammar.explanation: 光带笔就行 means a pen alone suffices in this context; it does not claim pens are the only permitted object. 仅/仅仅 restrict scope. 就两个人 emphasizes a small exact count. 至少两个人 sets a minimum of two, allowing more. 至少提前一天 sets a minimum lead time, not exactly one day. Keep only, sufficiency and minimum distinct.

grammar.pattern: 有的是：充足的数量
grammar.purpose: Describe plentiful supplies without claiming unlimited capacity
grammar.explanation: 材料有的是 / 有的是材料 says materials are plentiful. It does not give an exact number and does not transfer that abundance to seats, time or places. Distinguish the idiomatic plentiful construction from 有的材料…: some of the materials. In a practical notice, verify each resource separately.

grammar.pattern: 本来 / 才 / 曾经 / 从来 / 赶紧 / 赶快 / 立刻 / 连忙 / 始终 / 已 / 早已
grammar.purpose: Distinguish event time, quick response and prior expectations
grammar.explanation: 本来 presents an original situation or intention that may contrast with now. 曾经 marks a past experience, not a current habit. 从来没… means never up to the reference time; 从来都… can describe a consistent habit. 才知道 here is only then realizing, unlike 才两个 quantity limitation. 赶紧/赶快 urge prompt action, 立刻 means immediately, 连忙 a prompt response to circumstances. 始终 throughout covers a period. 已 is concise written 已经; 早已 emphasizes completion long before now.

examples.zh: 本来想明天问，今天才知道她已经到了。

examples.en: Originally meant to ask tomorrow; only today learned she had arrived.

examples.py: tā céng jīng zhù zhè lǐ , jiù diàn zǎo yǐ bān zǒu .
examples.en: She once lived here; the old shop moved long ago.

grammar.pattern: 自从 + 时间或事件
grammar.purpose: Anchor a continuing situation after a past starting point
grammar.explanation: 自从毕业，我们很少见面 establishes graduation as the starting point for infrequent meetings. The following clause supplies the subsequent situation; 自从 alone does not explain why it occurred. 自从她搬走以后 can include 以后. Do not use future 明天 as an already established past starting point.

grammar.pattern: 通常 / 往往 / 总 / 总是
grammar.purpose: Describe usual patterns and repeated behaviour
grammar.explanation: 通常 presents the usual situation with possible exceptions. 往往 emphasizes a tendency, often linked to circumstances. 总/总是 describes recurring behaviour and may be emphatic rather than a mathematically proved every-time claim. 他总忘记带水 is a conversational complaint, not a measured score. Distinguish habitual 总是 from 已经 for completion and 一直 for continuation.

examples.zh: 我们通常周末散步，但这周休息。

commonMistakes.why: A usual pattern allows an exception.

grammar.pattern: 动词 + 时量补语：持续多久
grammar.purpose: Place duration correctly with actions and objects
grammar.explanation: 走了二十分钟 describes a completed interval. 看书看了二十分钟 / 看了二十分钟书 both place duration with the action. 我学汉语学了两年了 normally presents an interval continuing to now; 我学了两年汉语 does not alone establish that it continues. Wait-duration 等了二十分钟 also does not prove the other person arrived. Do not treat a duration as a clock time.

grammar.pattern: 再：在一个条件或步骤之后
grammar.purpose: Place a further action after a stated prerequisite
grammar.explanation: 先听，再说 orders steps. 等听清楚了再加快 makes understanding a prerequisite. 再试一次 is another future attempt; 又试了一次 reports another past attempt. 再 also appears in 如果再听不懂… for a further hypothetical occasion. Do not infer that every 再 means an event already happened.

examples.en: Listen first, then speak.

examples.en: If still unable to understand on another attempt, change the method.

commonMistakes.wrong: 昨天再试了一次。
commonMistakes.why: Use 又 for a reported repeated past event in this context.

grammar.pattern: 互相 / 相互 / 尽量 / 亲自
grammar.purpose: Coordinate reciprocal help and personal action
grammar.explanation: 我们互相帮助 / 相互帮助 describes help in both directions, unlike 我帮你 alone. 尽量 says to do as much as circumstances allow; it does not guarantee the result. 亲自 says the person acts rather than delegating; it does not mean alone or without help. 我亲自读，你帮我听 is consistent.

examples.py: wǒ men hù xiāng bāng zhù .
examples.en: We help each other.

examples.zh: 尽量说清楚，不一定马上成功。

examples.en: Try to speak clearly; success need not be immediate.

grammar.pattern: 大概 / 恐怕
grammar.purpose: Signal uncertainty and an unwelcome possibility
grammar.explanation: 大概六点到 is an estimate, not a guarantee. 恐怕要下雨 often presents an unwelcome possibility politely; it is not simply the verb 害怕. Neither adverb proves the event occurred. 大约 estimates an amount or time; avoid silently upgrading any estimate to a confirmed appointment.

examples.en: She will probably arrive at six.

examples.en: I am afraid it may rain.

examples.py: dà gài huì lái , dàn hái méi què rèn .
examples.en: She will probably come, but it is not confirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 大概六点到，就是保证六点到。
commonMistakes.why: An estimate does not guarantee an exact time.

grammar.pattern: 要是……就……
grammar.purpose: Make a conditional plan
grammar.explanation: 要是下雨，就在室内见 states what to do under a condition, without asserting that the condition will occur. 就 belongs with the resulting plan. Use 如果 similarly, and distinguish a hypothetical consequence from a report of an event that has already happened.

examples.en: If it rains, meet indoors.

examples.en: If she has not arrived, we will message first.

commonMistakes.why: Keep the conditional plan separate from a completed cancellation.

grammar.pattern: 白 / 并 / 当然 / 到底 / 反正 / 根本 / 果然 / 简直 / 绝对 / 难道 / 其实 / 千万 / 确实 / 只好 / 终于
grammar.purpose: Track attitude and evidential limits
grammar.explanation: 白跑 means a trip in vain. 并没有 challenges an assumed cancellation; it is not English however by itself. 根本不是 strengthens negation. 果然 says a finding matches an expectation, not that expectation alone proves it. 其实 and 事实上 introduce a correction. 绝对 is a strong commitment; avoid it for a guess. 千万别 is emphatic caution, 只好 constrained choice, 终于 an eventual result. Attitude adverbs do not supply evidence.

grammar.pattern: 不是……吗？ / 难道……吗？
grammar.purpose: Recognize rhetorical force
grammar.explanation: 不是写着换房间吗？ points to information the speaker expects the listener to acknowledge. 难道旧图片就能证明今天取消了吗？ challenges that inference and expects no; it is not neutral uncertainty about any cancellation. Tone and context matter. For a genuinely open question use 活动取消了吗？ without forcing agreement.

grammar.pattern: 由：行动的负责方
grammar.purpose: Name the agent responsible for an action
grammar.explanation: 活动由学生举办 names the responsible agent before the action. Compare 场地由学校管理 with a person merely attending. A delegation or representative need not be the organizer. In these agentive examples 由 does not mean because; 由于 is a separate causal expression.

grammar.explanation: 按名单分组 gives the grouping basis, while 按照通知上的流程签到 gives a procedural basis. 按到达时间 and 按名单 may yield different groups; read which is stated. The verb 按 in 按按钮 is press, not the preposition according to.

grammar.pattern: 朝 + 方向 / 目标
grammar.purpose: Give a direction without claiming arrival
grammar.explanation: 朝门口走 names the direction of movement; it does not say the person has already reached the doorway. Compare 搬到门口, which specifies the resulting location. 朝这里走 depends on the speaker’s position. Verify which entrance or stairway is intended before moving a heavy object.

examples.en: Walk this way; do not go upstairs yet.

examples.en: Move it to the doorway and then stop.

commonMistakes.wrong: 朝门口走了，所以已经到门口了。
commonMistakes.right: 朝门口走了，还没说是否到达。
commonMistakes.why: Direction of motion does not establish the endpoint.

grammar.pattern: 出来 / 出去 / 过来 / 过去 / 回来 / 回去 / 进来 / 进去 / 起来 / 上来 / 上去 / 下来 / 下去
grammar.purpose: Interpret compound directional complements
grammar.explanation: 来 generally directs movement toward the reference speaker, 去 away. 我在二楼，你上来 contrasts with 我在一楼，你上去. 出/进 locate movement across a boundary, 回 indicates returning, 过 crossing toward or away from a point. 起来 can mean upward movement, not necessarily toward the speaker. With a location keep it before 来/去: 搬到门口来. Ask for the reference position when unclear; do not give dangerous lifting instructions.

grammar.pattern: 为：情绪或关心的对象
grammar.purpose: Identify whom an emotion or concern is directed toward
grammar.explanation: 我为你高兴 and 我为她担心 identify the person an emotion concerns. This object use extends, rather than repeats, the earlier beneficiary use 为朋友打印材料. Both use wèi, unlike wéi in 成为. Concern does not authorize deciding for the person; 我替她决定 acts in her place. Preserve the distinction between a feeling toward someone and an action intended to benefit them.

examples.zh: 我为你高兴，但不替你决定。
examples.py: wǒ wèi nǐ gāo xìng , dàn bù tì nǐ jué dìng .
examples.en: I am happy for you but do not decide for you.

examples.py: tā wèi péng you de shēn tǐ dān xīn .
examples.en: She is concerned about her friend’s health.

examples.zh: 别为我的选择着急，我会先问清楚。
examples.py: bié wèi wǒ de xuǎn zé zháo jí , wǒ huì xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Do not worry about my choice; I will clarify it first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我为她担心，所以她必须听我的。
commonMistakes.right: 我为她担心，也尊重她自己的选择。
commonMistakes.why: Concern is directed toward a person without removing their agency.

grammar.pattern: 对……来说
grammar.purpose: State a perspective rather than a universal judgement
grammar.explanation: 对我来说，安静很重要 locates the judgement in the speaker’s perspective. It does not establish that everyone prefers silence. 对新会员来说 also allows a group perspective, but avoid asserting uniform preferences without evidence. Compare 客观价格 with personally evaluated value.

examples.py: duì wǒ lái shuō , ān jìng hěn zhòng yào .
examples.en: For me, quiet matters.

examples.zh: 对她来说，今天休息更合适。
examples.py: duì tā lái shuō , jīn tiān xiū xī gèng hé shì .
examples.en: For her, rest today is more appropriate.

examples.zh: 对新会员来说，先看说明比较方便。
examples.py: duì xīn huì yuán lái shuō , xiān kàn shuō míng bǐ jiào fāng biàn .
examples.en: For new members, reading the explanation first is more convenient.

commonMistakes.wrong: 对我来说重要，所以对所有人都重要。
commonMistakes.right: 对我来说重要，对方的需要还要问。
commonMistakes.why: A personal perspective does not generalize to everyone.

lines.zh: 情感可以表达清楚，不必猜对方的答案。
lines.py: qíng gǎn kě yǐ biǎo dá qīng chǔ , bù bì cāi duì fāng de dá àn .
lines.en: Emotions can be expressed clearly without guessing the other person’s answer.

lines.zh: 她内心想参加，今天却太累。
lines.py: tā nèi xīn xiǎng cān jiā , jīn tiān què tài lèi .
lines.en: Inside she wants to join, but today she is too tired.

lines.zh: 交流思想，不必有完全一样的答案。
lines.py: jiāo liú sī xiǎng , bù bì yǒu wán quán yī yàng de dá àn .
lines.en: Exchange ideas; identical answers are not required.

lines.zh: 这个选择对她有自己的意义。
lines.py: zhè gè xuǎn zé duì tā yǒu zì jǐ de yì yì .
lines.en: This choice has its own significance for her.

lines.zh: 个人需要不一定一样。
lines.py: gè rén xū yào bù yí dìng yī yàng .
lines.en: Individual needs are not necessarily the same.

lines.zh: 先了解自身需要，再比较。
lines.py: xiān liǎo jiě zì shēn xū yào , zài bǐ jiào .
lines.en: Understand one’s own needs before comparing.

lines.zh: 她根据自身情况，决定先休息。
lines.py: tā gēn jù zì shēn qíng kuàng , jué dìng xiān xiū xī .
lines.en: She decides to rest first based on her own situation.

lines.zh: 先问对方有没有空。
lines.py: xiān wèn duì fāng yǒu méi yǒu kōng .
lines.en: Ask first whether the other person is free.

lines.zh: 对方还没说愿意，我们先不替她答应。
lines.py: duì fāng hái méi shuō yuàn yì , wǒ men xiān bù tì tā dā yìng .
lines.en: The other person has not said she is willing; do not agree on her behalf.

lines.zh: 这份说明的对象是新会员。
lines.py: zhè fèn shuō míng de duì xiàng shì xīn huì yuán .
lines.en: This explanation is intended for new members.

lines.zh: 按实际需要选择比较合理。
lines.py: àn shí jì xū yào xuǎn zé bǐ jiào hé lǐ .
lines.en: Choosing according to actual needs is more reasonable.

lines.zh: 把两个人的需要都问清楚，安排才合理。
lines.py: bǎ liǎng gè rén de xū yào dōu wèn qīng chǔ , ān pái cái hé lǐ .
lines.en: Clarifying both people’s needs makes the arrangement reasonable.

lines.zh: 听完她的理由，我能体会她的感受。
lines.py: tīng wán tā de lǐ yóu , wǒ néng tǐ huì tā de gǎn shòu .
lines.en: After hearing her reasons, I can appreciate her feelings.

lines.zh: 听她说今天很累，我能体会她想休息。
lines.py: tīng tā shuō jīn tiān hěn lèi , wǒ néng tǐ huì tā xiǎng xiū xī .
lines.en: Hearing she is tired today, I can appreciate her wish to rest.

lines.zh: 这个安排体现对不同需要的尊重。
lines.py: zhè gè ān pái tǐ xiàn duì bù tóng xū yào de zūn zhòng .
lines.en: This arrangement reflects respect for different needs.

lines.zh: 给她自己选，体现对她的尊重。
lines.py: gěi tā zì jǐ xuǎn , tǐ xiàn duì tā de zūn zhòng .
lines.en: Letting her choose reflects respect for her.

lines.zh: 她显然还没决定，别替她答应。
lines.py: tā xiǎn rán hái méi jué dìng , bié tì tā dā yìng .
lines.en: She evidently has not decided; do not agree on her behalf.

audio.zh: 她可以自主选择，我不替她决定。
audio.py: tā kě yǐ zì zhǔ xuǎn zé , wǒ bù tì tā jué dìng .
audio.en: She can choose independently; I do not decide for her.

audio.zh: 我理解你的感受，但我的需要不同。
audio.py: wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ de gǎn shòu , dàn wǒ de xū yào bù tóng .
audio.en: I understand your feelings, but my needs differ.

tasks.why: Understanding is distinct from identical needs.

line.en: Needs may be similar while choices differ.

grammar.pattern: 向：行为的对象
grammar.purpose: Direct an action toward a recipient
grammar.explanation: 向当地朋友请教 identifies the person approached for advice, not a physical compass direction. 向大家介绍 directs an explanation to an audience. This unit contrasts the action recipient with 朝门口走 from the previous unit. Asking one person does not make their answer representative of everyone.

examples.en: Ask a local friend for advice.

commonMistakes.wrong: 向朋友请教，所以所有人都这样做。
commonMistakes.right: 向朋友请教，再说明这是她的习惯。
commonMistakes.why: The recipient is an informant, not proof of universal practice.

grammar.pattern: 像……一样
grammar.purpose: Compare a stated feature without equating every feature
grammar.explanation: 像平时一样先问时间 compares the specific procedure of asking the time. 像朋友一样交流 compares a manner of interaction; it does not literally establish friendship. State the feature being compared. Avoid an analogy that turns a performance, ancient story or one host’s practice into a universal custom.

examples.py: xiàng píng shí yī yàng , xiān wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: As usual, ask the time first.

examples.en: Everyone communicates like friends.

examples.en: This time’s arrangement is like last time’s.

commonMistakes.right: 像朋友一样交流，是比较交流方式。
commonMistakes.why: A comparison of manner does not establish actual identity.

grammar.pattern: 由于 / 因为
grammar.purpose: Identify the actual cause
grammar.explanation: 由于地址写错 can introduce a cause noun phrase or clause. 因为我写错地址 directly identifies an agent and cause. 由于 is often more written; do not use it to obscure responsibility. A cause can explain a delay without excusing it. This unit concerns an incorrect address, not a real accident.

examples.zh: 由于地址写错，朋友走错了地方。
examples.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ xiě cuò , péng you zǒu cuò le dì fāng .
examples.en: Because the address was wrong, the friend went to the wrong place.

examples.zh: 因为我写错地址，你多走了一段。

examples.en: Because I wrote the wrong address, you travelled farther.

examples.zh: 因为没核对，我发了旧通知。

commonMistakes.wrong: 由于你看了我写错的地址，所以是你的问题。
commonMistakes.right: 因为我写错地址，让你多走了一段，对不起。
commonMistakes.why: Name the actual cause without shifting responsibility.

grammar.pattern: （由于）……，所以 / 因此……
grammar.purpose: Connect cause and consequence without inventing completion
grammar.explanation: 由于地址错了，因此需要发新地址 states a consequence and needed action, not proof that the new address has been sent. Compare 已经发送 with 现在要发送. 因此 is a concise written connector; 所以 is frequent conversationally. The consequence should follow from the stated cause, not from blame unrelated to the facts.

lines.zh: 你怎么到了另一个门口？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me dào le lìng yī gè mén kǒu ?
lines.en: How did you end up at the other entrance?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你发的地址是旧的，我多走了一段。
lines.py: nǐ fā de dì zhǐ shì jiù de , wǒ duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: The address you sent was old, and I travelled farther.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对不起，因为我没核对，发了旧地址。
lines.py: duì bù qǐ , yīn wèi wǒ méi hé duì , fā le jiù dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Sorry; because I did not check, I sent the old address.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 刚才你只说我应该早一点出发，我有点伤心。
lines.py: gāng cái nǐ zhǐ shuō wǒ yīng gāi zǎo yī diǎn chū fā , wǒ yǒu diǎn shāng xīn .
lines.en: Just now you only said I should have left earlier; I felt a little hurt.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 是我的错误，不是你的问题。我现在发正确地址。
lines.py: shì wǒ de cuò wù , bù shì nǐ de wèn tí . wǒ xiàn zài fā zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: It was my error, not your fault. I will send the correct address now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还有门牌号，别漏了。
lines.py: hái yǒu mén pái hào , bié lòu le .
lines.en: Include the building number too; do not omit it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，相关信息一起发。下次发送前再核对。
lines.py: hǎo , xiāng guān xìn xī yì qǐ fā . xià cì fā sòng qián zài hé duì .
lines.en: Okay; I will send the relevant information together and check again before sending next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢，先把通知改好。
lines.py: xiè xiè , xiān bǎ tōng zhī gǎi hǎo .
lines.en: Thanks; correct the notice first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 由于我没核对地址，朋友到了旧门口，多走了一段。
lines.py: yóu yú wǒ méi hé duì dì zhǐ , péng you dào le jiù mén kǒu , duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: Because I did not check the address, my friend reached the old entrance and travelled farther.

lines.zh: 这次事件没有人受伤，但朋友的时间被浪费了。
lines.py: zhè cì shì jiàn méi yǒu rén shòu shāng , dàn péng you de shí jiān bèi làng fèi le .
lines.en: No one was injured in this incident, but the friend’s time was wasted.

lines.zh: 我先听她的反应，再表达道歉，不把后果当她的问题。
lines.py: wǒ xiān tīng tā de fǎn yìng , zài biǎo dá dào qiàn , bù bǎ hòu guǒ dāng tā de wèn tí .
lines.en: I listen to her response before apologizing, without treating the consequence as her fault.

lines.zh: 通知漏了门牌号，因此现在补上并发送正确地址。
lines.py: tōng zhī lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng bìng fā sòng zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: The notice omitted the building number, so I add it now and send the correct address.

lines.zh: 发生了错误，消息消失也不能假装没发生。
lines.py: fā shēng le cuò wù , xiāo xī xiāo shī yě bù néng jiǎ zhuāng méi fā shēng .
lines.en: An error happened; even if the message disappears, do not pretend it did not happen.

lines.zh: 旧通知需要修正，不能宣布一个未经确认的新地点。
lines.py: jiù tōng zhī xū yào xiū zhèng , bù néng xuān bù yī gè wèi jīng què rèn de xīn dì diǎn .
lines.en: The old notice needs correcting; do not announce an unconfirmed new venue.

lines.zh: 我把信息弄乱了，就要认真对待修正，不急着说信任已经恢复。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ xìn xī nòng luàn le , jiù yào rèn zhēn duì dài xiū zhèng , bù jí zhe shuō xìn rèn yǐ jīng huī fù .
lines.en: I confused the information and must take correction seriously, without rushing to say trust has already recovered.

lines.zh: 完善通知是一次修正，下次发送前还要注意核对。
lines.py: wán shàn tōng zhī shì yī cì xiū zhèng , xià cì fā sòng qián hái yào zhù yì hé duì .
lines.en: Improving the notice is one repair; next time still check before sending.

questions.q: Does deleting a message erase the incident?
choices: Only if the old notice is gone

lines.zh: 【由于】我没核对地址，朋友到了旧门口，多走了一段。
lines.py: yóu yú wǒ méi hé duì dì zhǐ , péng you dào le jiù mén kǒu , duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: Because I did not check the address, my friend reached the old entrance and travelled farther.

lines.zh: 通知漏了门牌号，【因此】现在补上并发送正确地址。
lines.py: tōng zhī lòu le mén pái hào , yīn cǐ xiàn zài bǔ shàng bìng fā sòng zhèng què dì zhǐ .
lines.en: The notice omitted the building number, so I add it now and send the correct address.

lines.zh: 可是我也等了五分钟。
lines.py: kě shì wǒ yě děng le wǔ fēn zhōng .
lines.en: But I waited five minutes too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我们先改地址，不先比谁等得久。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān gǎi dì zhǐ , bù xiān bǐ shéi děng dé jiǔ .
lines.en: Let us correct the address first, not compete over who waited longer.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，是我发错了。
lines.py: hǎo , shì wǒ fā cuò le .
lines.en: Okay; I sent it incorrectly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这句比五分钟有用。
lines.py: zhè jù bǐ wǔ fēn zhōng yǒu yòng .
lines.en: That sentence is more useful than the five minutes.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Accepting the error and correcting it
questions.answer: Accepting the error and correcting it

lines.zh: 发生问题后，先说明情况。
lines.py: fā shēng wèn tí hòu , xiān shuō míng qíng kuàng .
lines.en: After a problem occurs, explain the situation first.

lines.zh: 这次事件需要记录经过。
lines.py: zhè cì shì jiàn xū yào jì lù jīng guò .
lines.en: This incident needs a record of what happened.

lines.zh: 事故和普通迟到不是同一个词。
lines.py: shì gù hé pǔ tōng chí dào bù shì tóng yī gè cí .
lines.en: Accident and ordinary lateness are not the same word.

lines.zh: 只是地址写错，没有发生事故。
lines.py: zhǐ shì dì zhǐ xiě cuò , méi yǒu fā shēng shì gù .
lines.en: Only the address was written incorrectly; no accident occurred.

lines.zh: 地址错误的后果是朋友多走了一段。
lines.py: dì zhǐ cuò wù de hòu guǒ shì péng you duō zǒu le yī duàn .
lines.en: The wrong address caused the friend to travel farther.

lines.zh: 道歉要表达责任，不只是理由。
lines.py: dào qiàn yào biǎo dá zé rèn , bù zhǐ shì lǐ yóu .
lines.en: An apology should express responsibility, not just reasons.

lines.zh: 正式声明不能把错误写成对方的问题。
lines.py: zhèng shì shēng míng bù néng bǎ cuò wù xiě chéng duì fāng de wèn tí .
lines.en: A formal statement should not turn one’s error into the other party’s fault.

lines.zh: 这份声明写清楚谁发错了地址。
lines.py: zhè fèn shēng míng xiě qīng chǔ shéi fā cuò le dì zhǐ .
lines.en: This statement makes clear who sent the wrong address.

lines.zh: 确认以后再宣布新地点。
lines.py: què rèn yǐ hòu zài xuān bù xīn dì diǎn .
lines.en: Announce the new venue after confirming it.

lines.zh: 地址前后不同，让人觉得奇怪。
lines.py: dì zhǐ qián hòu bù tóng , ràng rén jué de qí guài .
lines.en: The inconsistent addresses seem strange.

lines.zh: 两个通知地址不同，她觉得很奇怪。
lines.py: liǎng gè tōng zhī dì zhǐ bù tóng , tā jué de hěn qí guài .
lines.en: The notices have different addresses; she finds that strange.

lines.zh: 她有点伤心，因为道歉像是在怪她。
lines.py: tā yǒu diǎn shāng xīn , yīn wèi dào qiàn xiàng shì zài guài tā .
lines.en: She feels hurt because the apology sounds like blame.

lines.zh: 不要因为解释不清而失去信任。
lines.py: bú yào yīn wèi jiě shì bù qīng ér shī qù xìn rèn .
lines.en: Do not lose trust because of an unclear explanation.

lines.zh: 失去的时间不能直接补回来，但可以认真道歉。
lines.py: shī qù de shí jiān bù néng zhí jiē bǔ huí lái , dàn kě yǐ rèn zhēn dào qiàn .
lines.en: Lost time cannot simply be restored, but one can apologize sincerely.

lines.zh: 消息消失了，也不能假装没发生。
lines.py: xiāo xī xiāo shī le , yě bù néng jiǎ zhuāng méi fā shēng .
lines.en: Even if the message disappears, do not pretend nothing happened.

lines.zh: 认真对待朋友的时间。
lines.py: rèn zhēn duì dài péng you de shí jiān .
lines.en: Treat a friend’s time seriously.

lines.zh: 把相关信息一次发清楚。
lines.py: bǎ xiāng guān xìn xī yī cì fā qīng chǔ .
lines.en: Send all relevant information clearly at once.

grammar.pattern: 为了 + 目的
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a purpose from a recipient or cause
grammar.explanation: 为了方便带书 states the intended goal. 为朋友准备礼物 identifies the beneficiary instead. 因为她喜欢读书 gives a cause motivating the choice. An intended purpose is not proof that the goal has already been achieved; ask whether the bag fits the recipient’s books.

grammar.purpose: Link an intended purpose to the chosen action
grammar.explanation: 为了节约材料，我用了已有的纸 presents goal then action. It does not require 所以; distinguish causal 因为……所以 from purposive 为了. The alternative 我用了已有的纸，为了节约材料 is possible with context, but the exercise asks for the ordinary initial-purpose ordering. Keep the action concrete and verify the result separately.

grammar.pattern: 把 / 被 / 叫 / 让
grammar.purpose: Separate the actor and the affected object
grammar.explanation: 把 introduces a known object that the subject handles: 我把衣服挂好了. 被 introduces the agent of a passive event: 衣服被雨弄湿了; the agent may be omitted with 被. 叫 and 让 can also introduce a passive agent in colloquial speech: 衣服叫雨弄湿了 / 衣服让雨弄湿了. These passive uses require an agent and differ from 叫/让 meaning ask or allow. Do not infer the cause or actor from a bare changed state.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ yī fú guà hǎo le .
examples.en: I have hung up the clothes properly.

examples.py: yī fú bèi yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: The clothes were made wet by rain.

examples.zh: 衣服叫雨弄湿了，也可以说衣服让雨弄湿了。
examples.py: yī fú jiào yǔ nòng shī le , yě kě yǐ shuō yī fú ràng yǔ nòng shī le .
examples.en: One can colloquially say the clothes were made wet by rain using either 叫 or 让.

commonMistakes.wrong: 衣服叫弄湿了。
commonMistakes.why: For this agentless passive, use 被. With colloquial passive 叫/让, state the agent.

grammar.pattern: 把 + 已知物 + 处所 / 接收者 / 结果
grammar.purpose: Give the full handling instruction
grammar.explanation: Use a known or specified object, then a predicate describing its placement, transfer or changed state. Placement: 把包裹放在门边 / 放到门边. Transfer: 把这本书交给她. Result or direction: 把绳子解开 / 把箱子搬进去. The action alone in 请把书放 is incomplete here. Negation and modal verbs precede 把: 不要把衣服放地上; 可以把书交给她.

grammar.pattern: 除了 + 范围
grammar.purpose: Identify whether an exception or addition is intended
grammar.explanation: 除了 introduces a noun phrase or activity. Its interpretation depends on the following clause: 除了我，大家都来 excludes me; 除了看节目，我还听广播 adds an activity. 以外 can follow the phrase. The same 除了 phrase without its continuation does not decide the meaning by itself.

examples.py: chú le wǒ , dà jiā dōu lái le .
examples.en: Everyone except me came.

examples.zh: 除了看节目，我还听广播。
examples.py: chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ hái tīng guǎng bō .
examples.en: Besides watching programmes, I also listen to the radio.

examples.zh: 除了周末以外，她晚上也有空。
examples.py: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài , tā wǎn shang yě yǒu kōng .
examples.en: Besides weekends, she is also free in the evenings.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都来，所以我也来。
commonMistakes.right: 除了我，大家都来，我不来。
commonMistakes.why: In this 都 construction, the named person is excluded.

grammar.pattern: 除了……（以外），还 / 也 / 都……
grammar.purpose: Read the continuation and its scope
grammar.explanation: 还/也 commonly signal addition: 除了电视节目，她也看网上的视频. 都 commonly totals the remaining group after an exception: 除了我，大家都看过. State the remainder rather than treating 都 as a claim about all people everywhere. Do not infer whether another person joins from their preference for a similar activity.

examples.en: Besides the radio, I also watch TV programmes.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都看过，所以所有人都看过。
commonMistakes.why: The total applies to the remaining group, not the excluded member.

grammar.pattern: 并且 / 不光 / 不仅 / 另外 / 要是 / 因此 / 由于 / 只有
grammar.purpose: Connect clauses according to their relationship
grammar.explanation: 并且 adds a connected statement; 不光/不仅 introduce the first part of an additive pair with 还/也/而且. 另外 adds a separate point. 要是 introduces an if-condition, commonly answered by 就. 由于 introduces the cause clause and 因此 the consequence; here 由于……，因此…… links two clauses, contrasting the earlier preposition plus cause phrase. 只有 names a necessary condition with 才. Do not interchange cause, addition and condition just because all link statements.

examples.zh: 先确认地点，并且问清费用；另外，还要问人数。
examples.py: xiān què rèn dì diǎn , bìng qiě wèn qīng fèi yòng ; lìng wài , hái yào wèn rén shù .
examples.en: Confirm the venue and expenses; additionally ask the number of people.

examples.zh: 不光要问时间，还要问地点；不仅要公布，也要解释清楚。
examples.py: bù guāng yào wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn dì diǎn ; bù jǐn yào gōng bù , yě yào jiě shì qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Ask not only the time but the venue; not only announce it but explain clearly.

examples.zh: 要是下雨，就换室内；由于场地没批准，因此先不公布。

commonMistakes.wrong: 要是大家同意，因此大家同意。
commonMistakes.right: 要是大家同意，就再确认场地。
commonMistakes.why: An if-condition does not assert its own fulfillment; give the corresponding next action.

grammar.purpose: Name a necessary, not sufficient, condition
grammar.explanation: 只有大家同意才公布 sets agreement as necessary for announcing. It does not say agreement alone makes a venue available or forces an announcement. Contrast 要是大家同意，就再确认场地, an if-then step. 不同意就不公布 is compatible with the necessary condition; 同意了还要确认场地 is also compatible. Keep the stated condition and remaining requirements distinct.

examples.zh: 只有大家同意，才公布新安排。

commonMistakes.wrong: 只有大家同意才公布，所以同意以后一定立刻公布。

commonMistakes.why: A necessary condition alone does not guarantee immediate action.

lines.zh: 我主张先问每个人，并且确认场地。

lines.py: bù guāng yào wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn fèi yòng ; lìng wài , sī rén dì zhǐ bié gōng kāi .

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，只有大家同意，才公布。现在有人同意了，可以发了吗？
lines.py: hǎo , zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù . xiàn zài yǒu rén tóng yì le , kě yǐ fā le ma ?

lines.zh: 还不行，场地还没批准。我坚决不同意先发旧地址。
lines.py: hái bù xíng , chǎng dì hái méi pī zhǔn . wǒ jiān jué bù tóng yì xiān fā jiù dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Not yet; the venue is not approved. I firmly oppose sending an old address first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先制定清楚的规则，防止大家收到不同版本。
lines.py: xiān zhì dìng qīng chǔ de guī zé , fáng zhǐ dà jiā shōu dào bù tóng bǎn běn .
lines.en: First draw up clear rules to prevent people receiving different versions.

lines.zh: 只有大家同意，才公布；同意以后还要确认场地许可。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù ; tóng yì yǐ hòu hái yào què rèn chǎng dì xǔ kě .

lines.zh: 有人建议制定制度，也要检查入口，预防拥挤，确保大家收到同一通知，不能保证没有危险。
lines.py: yǒu rén jiàn yì zhì dìng zhì dù , yě yào jiǎn chá rù kǒu , yù fáng yōng jǐ , què bǎo dà jiā shōu dào tóng yī tōng zhī , bù néng bǎo zhèng méi yǒu wēi xiǎn .
lines.en: Someone suggests drawing up rules; still check the entrance, prevent crowding and ensure everyone receives the same notice, without guaranteeing an absence of danger.

lines.zh: 由于地址还没核实，因此先不发布；合法与否要看实际规定，不凭一句玩笑判断。
lines.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ hái méi hé shí , yīn cǐ xiān bù fā bù ; hé fǎ yǔ fǒu yào kàn shí jì guī dìng , bù píng yī jù wán xiào pàn duàn .
lines.en: Because the address is unverified, do not publish yet; legality depends on actual rules, not a joke.
